mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, name, kana, gender, birthday, email, password, phone_number AS phoneNumber, postal_code AS postalCode, address FROM t_users ORDER BY user_id

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.kana, u.gender, u.birthday, u.email, u.password, u.phone_number AS phoneNumber, u.postal_code AS postalCode, u.address, h.hobby_name AS hobbyName FROM t_users u LEFT JOIN t_hobby h ON u.hobby_id = h.hobby_id
u.delete_flag = 0
AND ( u.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
OR u.kana LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%' )
AND u.gender LIKE '%' || #{gender} || '%'
AND u.address LIKE '%' || #{address} || '%'
AND u.email LIKE '%' || #{email} || '%'
AND h.hobby_name = #{hobbyName}
ORDER BY u.kana
ORDER BY u.birthday
ORDER BY u.user_id
DESC
ASC
LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT user_id AS userId, name, kana, gender, birthday, email, password, phone_number AS phoneNumber, postal_code AS postalCode, address, hobby_id AS hobby FROM t_users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_users SET name = #{name}, kana = #{kana}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, birthday = #{birthday}, gender = #{gender}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, address = #{address}, hobby_id = #{hobby}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_users SET delete_flag = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
